definitions.explanation: Literally one word, but often means a brief comment or remark.

examples.japanese: {一言|ひとこと}お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.notes: Common request at events or gatherings

examples.japanese: {一言|ひとこと}{言|い}わせてください。
{彼|かれ}は{一言|ひとこと}も{話|はな}さなかった。
examples.english: He didn't say a single word.

notes:
Often used to request or offer a brief comment.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{一言|ひとこと}お{願|ねが}いします (Please say a few words)
・{一言|ひとこと}{言|い}わせてください (Let me say something)
・{一言|ひとこと}で{言|い}えば (in a word, to put it briefly)
・{一言|ひとこと}{多|おお}い (one word too many; talks too much)
・{一言|ひとこと}も{言|い}わない (not say a word)

ALTERNATIVE READING:
・いちごん - more formal, literary reading
・ひとこと - everyday usage

COUNTER NOTE:
・Despite meaning "one word," {一言|ひとこと} often refers to a brief statement, not literally a single word.
